name: NGC 152 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 152, an intermediate-age star cluster in the Small Magellanic Cloud, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc152-hubble
story: A crowd of stars in the Small Magellanic Cloud. Hubble studied it to learn why some clusters like it seem to hold stars of a range of ages, rather than stars all born at once.

claims.text: NGC 152 is a target of Hubble program 12908, 'What Causes Extended Main Sequence Turn-offs in Intermediate-Age Star Clusters?', one of 3 Magellanic Cloud star clusters
NGC 152 is an intermediate-age star cluster in the Small Magellanic Cloud
The extended main sequence turn-off is better explained by a range of stellar ages
